mapper.sql: si.support_inquiry_id, si.user_id, u.nickname AS user_nickname, u.email AS user_email, si.category, si.title, si.content, si.status, si.created_at, si.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_inquiries (user_id, category, title, content, status) VALUES (#{userId}, #{category}, #{title}, #{content}, 'OPEN')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM support_inquiries si JOIN users u ON u.user_id = si.user_id WHERE si.support_inquiry_id = #{inquiryId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM support_inquiries WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT sr.support_reply_id, sr.support_inquiry_id, sr.admin_user_id, u.nickname AS admin_nickname, sr.content, sr.created_at FROM support_replies sr LEFT JOIN users u ON u.user_id = sr.admin_user_id WHERE sr.support_inquiry_id = #{inquiryId} ORDER BY sr.created_at, sr.support_reply_id
